$Comment: Harvest Feast, the season after Hallow's Eve. The file name is the event id: every Season leaf,
spawn rule and Almanac page in the pack names it Harvest_Feast. Both days of the Window are in it,
counted in UTC because no Clock is written, so the feast runs from the first moment of November
20th to the last moment of December 1st, every year from FirstYear on. US Thanksgiving, the fourth
Thursday of November, always falls inside it.
A file that must vanish while the feast is off writes Season: Harvest_Feast, on itself or on the
base it inherits from. A conversation line reads ziggfreedcommon:feature with Param
Harvest_Feast_Live and Min 1 instead, and a roll or a lock reads ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live with
Presentation names the feast wherever events are listed, with the game's pumpkin pie as its
picture. Herald is the banner: Start shows once to each player, the first time they are on the
server during a run; End shows to everyone online when a run ends by its dates or by a command, and
never when the event is switched off.
A server owner switches the feast off, or moves its days, in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json
without touching this file. /zigcalendar status Harvest_Feast shows what the server reads.
